products.name: Oversized T-Shirt
products.description: An oversized T-shirt is a fashion-forward garment designed to be intentionally larger than standard sizing, offering a relaxed, baggy, and comfortable silhouette. Unlike simply wearing a larger size, these are intentionally designed with features like dropped shoulders, wider bodies, and longer sleeves.

products.name: Crop Hoodie
products.description: A crop hoodie is a stylish, shortened version of a traditional hooded sweatshirt, typically ending above the waistline to expose the midriff. It combines the cozy, athletic vibe of a hoodie—complete with a hood and often long sleeves or a kangaroo pocket—with a modern, fashionable silhouette.

products.name: Street Jacket
products.description: A street jacket (or streetwear jacket) is a versatile, casual outer garment designed for urban environments, blending comfort, function, and modern style. Rooted in 1990s hip-hop and skate culture, these jackets often feature oversized silhouettes, bold graphics, and functional elements.

products.name: Denim Jeans
products.description: Denim jeans are durable, versatile trousers made from denim, a sturdy cotton warp-faced twill fabric where the weft passes under two or more warp threads. Originally designed in the 1800s as rugged workwear for miners and laborers, they have evolved into a staple of modern fashion worldwide.

products.name: Denim Shirt
products.description: A denim shirt is a durable, ruggedly stylish top crafted from cotton twill fabric (often indigo-dyed) with a diagonal weave, typically featuring a button-down front, collar, and long sleeves. It is a versatile wardrobe staple available in various washes—from dark indigo to light, faded shades—and is popular for its "worn-in" comfort, longevity, and ease in layering, often styled as a casual shirt or an overshirt.

products.name: Urbano Hombre Jacket
products.description: This image features a stylish individual wearing a dark, deconstructed jacket over a matching vest and trousers, capturing a rugged, avant-garde aesthetic similar to Yohji Yamamoto designs.

products.name: Street fashion Combo
products.description: The image displays a man posing confidently against a modern textured wall while wearing a stylish, casual outfit. He is sporting a sleek black leather jacket layered over a dark grey t-shirt, giving him a classic edgy look. His attire is paired with slim-fit tan or khaki trousers that add a warm contrast to the darker upper layers. On his feet, he wears bright white sneakers that bring a clean, contemporary finish to the overall ensemble. Completing the look, he wears dark sunglasses and leans back with one foot up against the wall in a relaxed posture.

products.name: Biker Jacket
products.description: The outfit features a classic black leather biker jacket worn over a simple grey top. This edgy upper layer is paired with comfortable blue jeans for a casual look. Aviator-style sunglasses with brown tinted lenses add a cool, stylish touch. Her long, straight blonde hair flows naturally down her shoulders to complement the ensemble. Overall, the combination creates a timeless, rebellious, yet effortlessly chic street-style aesthetic.

products.name: T-Shirt & Beanie Combo
products.description: The man is wearing a casual streetwear outfit consisting of a plain, loose-fitting black crewneck t-shirt with short sleeves. On his head, he sports a classic, snug-fitting black beanie that covers his ears and hair. He is paired with black athletic track pants featuring a thin, subtle vertical stripe running down the side of each leg. On his feet, he wears a pair of low-top black sneakers with a contrasting white sole. The entire ensemble follows a cohesive, monochromatic all-black aesthetic suitable for movement or casual wear.

products.name: Longline Shrug
products.description: The model is wearing a chic and vibrant contemporary ensemble featuring a sleeveless, draped peach-colored vest as the standout piece. Beneath the open vest, she sports a fitted black top and matching black slim-fit trousers that create a sleek, neutral base. Her neckline is adorned with a bold, statement-making collar necklace encrusted with large, multicolored jewel tones. This colorful theme is mirrored on her wrist with a chunky, stacked beaded bracelet boasting a mix of bright neon shades. The entire outfit perfectly balances structured tailoring with playful, high-contrast accessories for a sophisticated yet energetic fashion statement.

products.name: Leather Trench Coat
products.description: The outfit features a long, tailored black leather trench coat worn open over a matching black leather minidress. The structured outerwear creates a dramatic silhouette with sharp lapels and long sleeves. A chic black leather crescent-shaped handbag accents the look, detailed with cascading silver metal chains. Round, dark-tinted sunglasses and a minimal black wristwatch elevate the edgy aesthetic. This monochromatic ensemble combines textured leather layers for a bold, matrix-inspired streetwear style.

products.name: Skater-Style Outfit
products.description: The woman is wearing a casual, summer-ready skater-style outfit highlighted by a vibrant teal and white plaid button-up shirt. The shirt features short sleeves and is playfully tied in a knot at the front to create a cropped, midriff-baring silhouette. Underneath the unbuttoned plaid top, a hint of a bright orange bikini top or bralette adds a pop of contrasting color. She pairs the top with low-rise, light-wash denim cutoff shorts that feature subtle distressing and a frayed hemline. Completing her streetwear look are a pair of retro, wide-framed white sunglasses and a high bun hair updo that accentuates the carefree, sunny aesthetic.

products.name: Burnout T-shirt
products.description: An edgy, modern outfit combines a breezy, semi-sheer white crewneck t-shirt with classic vibrant blue denim jeans. This casual pairing is elevated by bold accessories, including an oversized layered beaded statement necklace, stacked black bracelets, and sleek wire-frame sunglasses. The look balances effortless comfort with high-fashion streetwear elements.

products.name: Green Leather Coat
products.description: This stylish street-style outfit features a long, double-breasted trench coat in a rich olive green leather material. Underneath the structured outerwear, the individual wears a minimalist black bandeau bralette that highlights a bare midriff. The look is paired with high-waisted, relaxed-fit black leather trousers that add a sleek texture to the ensemble. Layered delicate gold chain necklaces accessorize the open neckline, adding a subtle touch of elegance. Completing the modern aesthetic, a matching olive green slouchy handbag is held at the side, tying the color palette together perfectly.

products.name: White Blazer & Mini Dress
products.description: This stylish outfit features a light-colored, thigh-length sleeveless dress decorated with a delicate dark floral or botanical pattern throughout. Layered over the dress is a structured, long-sleeved cream blazer left unbuttoned to maintain a relaxed yet sophisticated silhouette. The ensemble is accessorized with bold, white-framed cat-eye sunglasses that introduce a retro and chic flair to the overall look. Her dark, wavy hair cascades naturally over her shoulders, complementing the soft, feminine aesthetic of the floral attire.

products.name: Blazer with White Shirt
products.description: The man wears a smart-casual ensemble featuring a tailored navy blue blazer layered over a crisp, unbuttoned white dress shirt. This is paired with slim-fit beige chinos secured by a classic black leather belt. He completes the sharp look with sockless black leather loafers, making it perfect for a modern city setting.
